caption: The drawing features a statue of a female figure standing on a rectangular base labeled “CIGARS” in white letters. The figure is depicted with brown skin and long dark hair, wearing a red dress with a blue sash draped across her chest and waist, decorated with a striped pattern at the hem. She is adorned with blue feathers on her headband, a yellow band on her head, and wears a red necklace. Her left arm is bent at the elbow with the forearm raised vertically, holding a cylindrical object with gold bands at the top. Her right arm is resting at her side. The base on which she stands is shaded to resemble wood grain. In the lower corners of the drawing, there are two smaller line sketches of the statue from different angles, showing the form and base measurements. The background is plain, with a thin rectangular border framing the drawing and the sketches. The color palette primarily consists of red, blue, brown, yellow, and white.
title: Cigar Store Indian
